snippet.title: NTE gamescom2025 Special Video | Hethereau Exclusive Feature
snippet.description:
NTE is officially coming to #PS5 , and the PlayStation Game Hub is now live!
Add NTE to your wishlist today: https://pwgam.es/4fMfIKQ

Keep your hands on the wheel, Appraiser. The Officer Whisker chasing you aren't to be taken lightly.
Trust me, you really don't want to know what "Justice Executioner" has in store.
For now, enjoy the daily grind in Hethereau—your urban adventure is just getting started.

NTE is currently featured at gamescom 2025.
Visit [Hall 10.1 - A070] to experience the hands-on demo.

NTE Pre-Registration Is Live!
Pre-register for NTE: https://pwgam.es/3F0KXDO

Follow our official channels for the latest on NTE!
X: https://x.com/NTE_GL
Discord: https://discord.gg/nte
